free_tier.stated: The Free plan (30,000 credits a month) includes 1 GB of network transfer and 2 GB-months of storage; storage beyond that draws from the monthly credits at 420 credits per GB-month. Artifact retention default and maximum is 30 days.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: 3 GB maximum size for an individual artifact file
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Artifact retention default AND maximum is 30 days on Cloud; storage usage is a billed meter, not an allowance

egress.terms: Free download from app.circleci.com; artifacts are 'protected with your CircleCI account for private projects'. Public-project artifacts are reachable, private are not.

tooling: REST v2 artifacts endpoint; artifacts stored on Amazon S3 behind CircleCI. No rclone backend, no first-class bulk client.
chaining: Unlimited projects x 3 GB per file, but the 30-day hard ceiling makes this a rolling buffer, not storage.

limits.value: retention default AND maximum is 30 days

limits_note: 3 GB max per individual artifact file; retention 30 days maximum (workspaces/caches 15 days max); storage beyond plan is billed.

identity_cost.detail: an email address for GitHub, GitLab or Cursor Origin projects; a Bitbucket account for Bitbucket Cloud projects; the Free plan needs no credit card

reliability_note: 30-day deletion is unconditional and irreversible. Purely a CI convenience store.
